chunks: And whoever calls upon another god besides Allah, for which he has no proof, his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not prosper.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who worship other gods without proof?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the necessity of 'Burhan' (demonstrative proof) for any claimed divinity, critiquing blind imitation (Taqlid) in matters of belief. It highlights that the ultimate reckoning for polytheists is direct and personal before Allah, reinforcing the concept of individual accountability central to Shia theology.
